accuracy.body_dimensions: Samsung published chassis dimensions. Corner radii, edge rolls and curvature are photo estimates, not CAD.
accuracy.screen_resolution: Samsung native resolution. Active rectangle calculated from rounded published full diagonal and native aspect; physical bezel widths therefore approximate.
accuracy.screen_geometry: Model-specific flat/dual-edge display, rectangular/rounded corners, bezel selfie or Infinity-O aperture. Radii, hole positions and curve depth are photo estimates.
accuracy.camera_geometry: Model-specific rear layout scaled from generate_galaxy_svgs.PHONES / base MODELS official-render measurements. Internal optics, radii and protrusions illustrative; early cover internal lens positions estimated from photographs. Laser/ToF/heart-rate/fingerprint features distinguished from imaging lenses.
accuracy.finishes: Published finish names; approximate sampled sRGB and material response. S21+ Phantom Violet uses muted rose champagne camera housing.
accuracy.omissions: USB/headphone ports, speaker perforations, antenna seams and S Pen silo omitted. Legacy capacitive navigation marks and bezel hardware simplified.
